pack.name: SAP ECC + S/4HANA SoD Rule Set
pack.description: Standard Segregation of Duties rule set for SAP ECC and S/4HANA covering Financial Accounting, Materials Management, Sales & Distribution, Human Resources, Basis, Treasury, and cross-module risks. Equivalent to SAP GRC standard content.
pack.author: GovernexPlus
pack.license_note: Shipped with GovernexPlus v1.0. Customize freely after activation.
pack.changelog: Initial release — 30 SoD rules across FI, MM, SD, HR, BASIS, TR

items.name: Create and Approve Vendor
items.description: User can both create vendors (FK01/MK01) and approve vendor master changes (FK08) — segregation of duties violation in Accounts Payable.

payload.business_justification: Separation between AP creation and approval prevents fraudulent vendor creation used in payment fraud schemes.
payload.mitigation_hint: Periodic review of vendor master changes by AP supervisor

items.name: Post and Approve Vendor Invoices
items.description: User can post vendor invoices (FB60/MIRO) and also approve/release payment runs (F110) — classic AP fraud risk.

payload.business_justification: Posting and approving payments by the same person enables AP fraud.
recommended_actions: Separate invoice entry from payment release roles
payload.mitigation_hint: Independent payment approval by finance manager

items.name: Maintain Bank Master and Execute Payments
items.description: User can update bank master data (FI12) and also execute payment runs (F110) — allows fraudulent bank account substitution.

payload.business_justification: Bank master changes combined with payment execution is a critical fraud risk.
recommended_actions: Restrict bank master to treasury team only
payload.mitigation_hint: Four-eyes principle on bank master changes

items.name: Create and Release Purchase Orders
items.description: User can create purchase orders (ME21N) and also release/approve them (ME29N) — bypasses procurement authorization controls.

payload.business_justification: Self-approval of purchase orders circumvents procurement controls.
recommended_actions: Implement mandatory two-level approval workflow for POs

items.name: Maintain GL Accounts and Post Journal Entries
items.description: User can create/change GL account master (FS00) and also post journal entries (FB50/F-02) — allows creation of fictitious accounts.

payload.business_justification: GL master maintenance combined with posting enables financial statement manipulation.
recommended_actions: Restrict GL master maintenance to accounting team leads

items.name: Create Goods Receipt and Approve Invoice
items.description: User can post goods receipts (MIGO/MB01) and also verify/approve vendor invoices (MIRO) for the same purchase order.

payload.business_justification: The three-way match (PO/GR/Invoice) requires different people for GR and invoice approval.
recommended_actions: Separate receiving and invoice approval functions

items.name: Maintain Vendor Master and Post Goods Receipt
items.description: User can create/change vendor master (XK01/MK02) and post goods receipts (MIGO) — combined procurement fraud risk.

payload.business_justification: Vendor master access combined with goods receipt enables fictitious vendor payments.
recommended_actions: Separate vendor master maintenance from goods receipt
payload.mitigation_hint: Weekly new vendor report reviewed by AP manager

items.name: Maintain Payroll Data and Execute Payroll Run
items.description: User can change employee payroll data (PA20/PA30) and also execute the payroll run (PC00_M99_CALC) — enables ghost employee fraud.

payload.business_justification: Payroll data maintenance combined with payroll execution enables ghost employee and salary manipulation fraud.
recommended_actions: Separate HR master data from payroll execution roles
payload.mitigation_hint: Payroll reconciliation report reviewed by Finance

items.name: Create Employee and Assign Roles
items.description: User can create new employee records in HR (PA40) and also assign SAP system roles (SU01) — enables unauthorized access provisioning.

payload.business_justification: HR employee creation combined with user account management enables unauthorized access provisioning.
recommended_actions: Separate HR and IT administration roles completely
payload.mitigation_hint: New hire access log reviewed monthly

items.name: Create Sales Orders and Process Billing
items.description: User can create sales orders (VA01) and also process billing documents (VF01/VF31) — revenue recognition conflict.

payload.business_justification: Sales order creation combined with billing enables premature or fictitious revenue recognition.
recommended_actions: Separate order entry from billing functions
payload.mitigation_hint: AR aging report reviewed weekly by Credit Manager

items.name: Administer Users and Manage Roles
items.description: User has both SU01 (user administration) and PFCG (role management) access — can grant themselves any access.

payload.business_justification: Combined user and role administration is the highest SAP access risk — enables unrestricted privilege escalation.
recommended_actions: Strict separation: user admin and role admin in different teams
payload.mitigation_hint: All role changes reviewed by CISO quarterly

items.name: Create and Execute Treasury Transactions
items.description: User can create treasury/cash management transactions (TM01) and also execute them — treasury fraud risk.

payload.business_justification: Treasury deal creation and execution by the same person is a critical financial control weakness.
payload.mitigation_hint: Daily treasury transaction report reviewed by CFO
